more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US permission is limited to the uses and conditions in 21 CFR 137.105, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.uses: Permitted in the US for specified flour bleaching or ageing treatments, subject to the applicable standard of identity.
more_info.overview: Nitrosyl chloride is a chlorine-containing nitrogen oxide compound. The US flour standard lists it among the agents used for bleaching and artificial ageing of flour. Its relevance to food is a flour-treatment application during manufacture. The treatment entry does not establish a food-additive ADI.
